breakpoints.code: return mrb_load_exec(mrb, mrb_parse_file_continue(mrb, fp, leading.b, bufsize, c), c);

breakpoints.note: First project-code materialization of the vulnerability-relevant argument alias. `Exception.exception`/`Class#new` binds its current arguments into `argv`, and on the witnessed path that pointer aliases the live VM stack rather than a separate heap copy.

Root cause fixed on the witnessed crash path. This stack-growth call can reallocate and free `mrb->c->stbase` while `argv` still aliases that old stack, but vulnerable code does not repair `argv` before the later `stack_copy()` use. The staged patch replaces this call with `mrb_stack_extend_adjust(mrb, n + argc + 3, &argv)`.

Crash sink. The stale `argv` pointer is forwarded as `src` after VM stack reallocation has freed the old stack buffer, so this copy performs the saved heap-use-after-free read.
